verdict.rationale: Deel doesn't document a native in-product AI insights/analytics feature; the only AI-related capability evidenced is the MCP server that lets external agents (Claude, ChatGPT) query contracts/payroll/time data, including a tool (calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts) that can generate cost-comparison style insights — but this is agent-driven via an external client, not an insight surface inside Deel's own UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in Deel AI assistant, in-app recommendations/suggestions, or dashboards surfacing AI-generated insights without requiring an external MCP client.
